The lower age bound of 6 months cannot be expressed in whole years. The rule uses min age 1 (declared as derived), so infants aged 6-11 months are not covered. Human review is needed.
Fair skin type is encoded as uncomputable. Skin type (for example Fitzpatrick type) is not reliably held in structured EHR data, so the denominator cannot be fully computed.

Counseling documentation has no concept in the vocabulary, and the text states no frequency or interval. The numerator is therefore encoded as uncomputable rather than inventing a concept or a lookback window.
For young children, the counseling may go to the parents rather than the patient. This recipient distinction is captured only in the uncomputable numerator's description.
The DATE field carries an asterisk ('March 2018 *') whose footnote is not included in the section text. Its meaning is not represented.
